name: Sudoku Race
hook: Same sudoku for everyone. First to fill it wins.
how: Everyone gets the same puzzle at once. Fill every row, column and box with 1 to 9 while you watch your rivals' progress bars and which squares they've filled (never their digits). A wrong digit adds 10 seconds, so don't guess. Switch to Co-op to solve one grid together.
controls: Click or tap a square, then type or tap a number; Shift+number or ✎ Pencil for notes, arrow keys to move
uses: The host's browser picks the puzzle, collects finish times and starts the next race; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot racers solve at a human pace (and make mistakes) when the room is quiet.
Fastest race time for each difficulty, penalties included.
Rivals' progress and filled squares update live; in Co-op everyone fills one grid and sees each other's cursors.
The owner can change how many seconds a mistake costs without a new deploy.
ideas: Make it a 6×6 sudoku with letters instead of numbers
Give the winner a crown that shows next to their name in the next race
Add a hint button that fills one square but costs 30 seconds
